agyPathHint: Leave blank to auto-detect via PASEO_AGY_BIN, PATH, ~/.local/bin/agy, or Homebrew.
progressUpdatesHint: Ask AGY to give brief milestone updates during longer tasks.
timeoutHint: Maximum time to hold an active turn while waiting on background tasks, subagents, or Swarm workers (1–1440).
builtInRootsHint: Canonical realpath-checked skill directories automatically approved for read/search tools only.
extraRootsHint: One path per line (supports ~/). Shell, write, edit, web, and MCP tools still require approval.
saveLabel: Apply configuration to newly opened sessions
openSwarmSlashDesc: Open the live Antigravity Swarm visualizer panel for this agent
emptySwarmTitle: No active Swarm in this conversation
emptySwarmBody: Start a native Antigravity Swarm by switching this session to Full access and asking AGY to load the swarm skill (or run /swarm). Once workers are added, the shared board, member activity, and @mention graph appear here automatically.
fullAccessHint: Switch this session to Full access before starting /swarm so background workers do not stall on headless approvals.
noMessagesMatch: No board posts match the current filter.
noEdgesYet: No @mention edges recorded between task workers yet.
